tool.name: CIRIquant
tool.description: circRNA detection and quantification from paired-end RNA-Seq data
tool.command:
@APPLY_PY3_PATCH@ mkdir -p @OUTDIR@/align @OUTDIR@/gene @OUTDIR@/circ &&
## The reference (and its BWA / HISAT2 indices) is always taken from the history and ## indexed on the fly: a cached reference would require matching HISAT2 *and* BWA ## index data tables for the same dbkey. ln -s '${reference_source.fasta}' ref.fa && samtools faidx ref.fa && bwa index -p bwa_idx ref.fa 2> bwa_index.log && hisat2-build -q -p \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4} ref.fa hisat_idx && ln -s '${annotation}' annotation.gtf &&
## Give the read symlinks explicit extensions so that gzipped input is recognized #if $reads_r1.is_of_type('fastq.gz'): #set $fq1 = 'reads_r1.fq.gz' #set $fq2 = 'reads_r2.fq.gz' #else: #set $fq1 = 'reads_r1.fq' #set $fq2 = 'reads_r2.fq' #end if ln -s '${reads_r1}' $fq1 && ln -s '${reads_r2}' $fq2 &&
CIRIquant @THREADS@ -1 '$fq1' -2 '$fq2' --config '$config_file' -o @OUTDIR@ -p sample -a '${sec_advanced.anchor}' -l '${sec_advanced.library_type}' #if $sec_advanced.no_gene: --no-gene #end if #if $sec_advanced.no_fsj: --no-fsj #end if #if $sec_advanced.bsj_reads_out: --bsj-file '$bsj_reads' #end if #if str($circ_input.circ_input_selector) == "bed": --bed '${circ_input.bed}' #elif str($circ_input.circ_input_selector) == "circ_tool": --circ '${circ_input.circ}' --tool '${circ_input.tool}' #end if #if $rnaser_gtf: --RNaseR '${rnaser_gtf}' #end if
## Collect the outputs && mv @OUTDIR@/sample.gtf '$output_gtf' #if str($circ_input.circ_input_selector) != "bed": && mv @OUTDIR@/sample.bed '$output_bed' #end if && mv @OUTDIR@/align/sample.sorted.bam '$output_bam' #if not $sec_advanced.no_gene: && mv @OUTDIR@/gene/sample_out.gtf '$gene_gtf' #end if && mv @OUTDIR@/sample.log '$log'

configfiles.configfile: ## Tool binaries are resolved from PATH inside the conda environment. reference: fasta: ref.fa gtf: annotation.gtf bwa_index: bwa_idx hisat_index: hisat_idx

param.label: Forward reads (R1)
param.help: Paired-end RNA-Seq data only; gzip compression supported

param.name: reads_r2
param.label: Reverse reads (R2)
param.help: Mate file corresponding to the forward reads

param.name: reference_source_selector
param.label: Reference genome source
param.option: Use a genome from the history

param.name: fasta
param.label: Reference genome FASTA
param.help: The .fai, BWA and HISAT2 indices are built on the fly

param.name: annotation
param.label: Gene annotation
param.help: GTF or GFF3 annotation of the host genome

param.name: circ_input_selector
param.label: circRNA candidates to quantify
param.option: Detect circRNAs de novo with CIRI2 (default)
Quantify circRNAs from a BED file
Quantify circRNAs predicted by another tool

param.name: bed
param.label: Putative circRNAs (BED)
param.help: Column 4 must hold the circRNA identifier in ``chrom:start|end`` notation

param.name: circ
param.label: circRNA predictions
param.help: Raw output of the selected prediction tool

param.name: rnaser_gtf
param.label: CIRIquant GTF of the RNase R treated sample
param.help: Second pass of the two-step RNase R correction workflow: adds ``rnaser_bsj``/``rnaser_fsj`` attributes and RNase R treatment statistics to the output header

param.name: anchor
param.label: Minimum anchor length for junction alignment

param.name: no_gene
param.label: Skip StringTie host gene abundance estimation
param.help: Also disables RNase R correction and all downstream differential expression analyses

param.name: bsj_reads_out
param.label: Write the IDs of BSJ supporting reads to a file

tool.help:
**What it does**
CIRIquant detects and quantifies circular RNAs (circRNAs) from paired-end RNA-Seq data. The reads are aligned to the reference genome with HISAT2, circRNAs are detected de novo with the packaged CIRI2 detector, back-splice junction (BSJ) and forward-splice junction (FSJ) reads are quantified with BWA against pseudo-circular references, host gene abundance is estimated with StringTie, and a normalized circRNA GTF is produced.
-----
**Input modes**
Three modes are available for choosing the circRNAs to quantify:
- **De novo** (default): CIRI2 detects circRNAs from the alignment of un-/discordantly mapped reads. - **BED file**: you provide putative circRNAs; column 4 must hold the circRNA identifier in `chrom:start|end` notation. - **Third-party predictions**: circRNAs predicted by CIRI2, CIRCexplorer2, DCC, KNIFE, MapSplice, UROBORUS, circRNA_finder or find_circ.
-----
**RNase R effect correction**
CIRIquant supports a two-step workflow for samples with a matched RNase R treated library: first quantify the RNase R treated sample itself, then re-run CIRIquant on the untreated sample supplying that result as **CIRIquant GTF of the RNase R treated sample**. The output then carries the additional `rnaser_bsj`/`rnaser_fsj` attributes and RNase R treatment statistics in its header, which are required for the RNase R aware differential expression analysis with CIRI_DE.
-----
**Output**
The main output GTF contains one `circRNA` feature per circRNA. The score column holds the CPM-normalized expression and the attributes are:
=============== ============================================================ Attribute Meaning =============== ============================================================ `circ_id` `chrom:start|end` identifier of the circRNA `circ_type` `exon`, `intron`, `antisense` or `intergenic` `bsj` estimated number of back-splice junction supporting reads `fsj` estimated number of forward-splice junction supporting reads `junc_ratio` `2*bsj / (2*bsj + fsj)` `gene_id` host gene identifier (comma-joined for multi-gene overlaps) `gene_name` host gene name `gene_type` host gene biotype =============== ============================================================
The `##Sample`, `##Total_Reads`, `##Mapped_Reads` and `##Circular_Reads` header lines hold the library statistics used for normalization. Further outputs are the circRNA BED, the sorted HISAT2 alignment (BAM) and, unless host gene abundance estimation was skipped, the StringTie gene abundance GTF.
.. class:: warningmark
**Do not skip StringTie host gene abundance estimation** if you plan to run CIRI_DE or prep_CIRIquant afterwards: both require the gene abundance information.
-----
**Downstream analysis**
- **CIRI_DE** performs pairwise circRNA differential expression (DE) and isoform switching (DS) analysis on two CIRIquant GTFs without replicates. - **prep_CIRIquant** builds count matrices (library information, circRNA annotation, BSJ counts, junction ratios) from replicate CIRIquant GTFs for differential expression analysis with DESeq2/edgeR.
For further details see the [CIRI-cookbook](https://ciri-cookbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/CIRIquant_0_home.html).
